cohort: 469 patients who underwent extra facial total laparoscopic hysterectomy between 2013 and 2020 at a tertiary center
finding: Total laparoscopic hysterectomy performed by experienced surgeons has advantages over open surgery, but higher BMI, surgeon inexperience, history of caesarean section, comorbidities, and uterine weight ≥ 300 g are associated with increased risk of complications.
mod_finding: History of caesarean section was found to be associated with postoperative complications.
